title: Coverage no longer creating coverage.dat

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request / question:

I'm running the following command: bazel coverage ... 

In 0.4.2rc2, this worked well and produced coverage.dat files as expected. In the latest version 0.4.5rc7, this does not work. The coverage.dat files are not being produced. I receive the following errors:

ERROR: /home/tomw/dev/build_test_bazel/cpp/utils/policies/BUILD:19:1: output 'cpp/utils/policies/utils_policies-unittest/coverage.dat' was not created.
ERROR: /home/tomw/dev/build_test_bazel/cpp/utils/policies/BUILD:19:1: not all outputs were created or valid.

This also failed to work on 0.4.4 and 0.4.5rc2. 

### Environment info
* Operating System:
CentOS release 6.5 (Final)

* Bazel version (output of `bazel info release`):
release 0.4.4-2017-03-15 (@336f477)

### Anything else, information or logs or outputs that would be helpful?
